job:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

Tribune Tech is a Series B fintech platform rebuilding payments infrastructure for regional banks. We're looking for a product designer to own the user experience of our core dashboard and partner closely with our engineering team to ship features that matter.

You'll work on real problems: compliance-friendly design, high-stakes transaction interfaces, and tools that help non-technical users navigate complex workflows. This is not a large-team role—you'll work directly with engineers, product managers, and occasionally customers.

MUST-HAVES

• 3+ years professional product design experience
• Proficiency in Figma
• Hands-on experience running usability tests (moderated or unmoderated)
• Shipped products directly with engineering teams—not just handoffs

NICE-TO-HAVES

• Experience across multiple domains (fintech, health, e-commerce, etc.)
• Familiarity with design systems
• Basic understanding of compliance or financial product constraints

requirements.note: short tenures must not erase real work
